name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
steps: Face a high cable bar and grasp it overhand with your elbows bent beside your ribs.
Straighten both elbows to bring the bar down in front of your thighs.
Let the bar rise until your forearms return near horizontal.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed and your elbows beside your waist.
Avoid leaning over the bar or letting your elbows flare outward as you push down.
